metaDescription: The complete list of mods in FizzleSMP, organized by category — world generation, combat, gameplay, economy, social, protection, admin, utility, and performance.
ogDescription: Over 100 curated mods across nine categories. Every mod is here for a reason.
title: Mod List
lede: Every mod in FizzleSMP, organized by category. Each one is here for a reason — nothing is filler.
